g.text: Compressed first-mode branch Gᵤ(W), W = V + V⁻¹
Stream F₁ and F₂ as pairs a(W) + b(W)V
Reduce modulo Gᵤ(W) and V² − WV + 1; retain phase P = Vⁿ − u
Only then: capped lift → phase filter → actual C₂ filter
Union + exact zero test + scale → original recovery state
Same cap7: 40 completions / 235 fallbacks (275 attempts; no timing claim)
